calculation_handling.description: The lawful height of a lawfully existing portable classroom building that exceeds the permitted maximum height becomes its maximum height.
calculation_handling.gaps: As-built heights of existing buildings are not held; the Residential Apartment, Commercial and IE zone categories are not in the zone vocabulary.

calculation_handling.description: An addition or extension to a lawfully existing portable classroom building must comply with the permitted maximum height or be authorized by a Section 45 Planning Act minor variance.
calculation_handling.gaps: Existing building facts are not held.

150.48.60.41(1).explanation: If a lawfully existing portable classroom building is taller than the permitted maximum height, its lawful height becomes the maximum for that building.

150.48.60.41(2).explanation: An addition or extension to such a building must meet the permitted maximum height or be authorized by a Section 45 Planning Act minor variance.
